claims.text: The launch signaled a strategic shift in the direction of frontier reasoning models toward integrating vision directly into the model architecture rather than bolting it on, as well as incorporating native tool use (such as web search and code interpreter) trained into the model itself [Source: ev-1].

The release was designed to defend OpenAI’s position at the reasoning-model frontier against competitors like DeepSeek and Anthropic by reframing frontier capability as "tool-using reasoning at commodity prices" [Source: ev-1].
This strategy involved using budget forcing with task-adaptive compute, allowing harder questions to think longer within a fixed maximum thought budget [Source: ev-1].

Additionally, o3 set a record on the ARC-AGI benchmark, achieving about 87.5% on ARC-AGI-1 at high compute, which met or exceeded the ~85% human baseline—the first model to reach this milestone [Source: ev-1].
